title: Departure-Day Rates for Upgrades into First
content:
**Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand — timing of a paid upgrade into First.** The First upgrade price is multiplied by the **departure-day rate**, which follows the whole days from today to the segment's scheduled departure date. The rate acts on the unrounded price; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

| Whole days from today to the scheduled departure date | Departure-day rate |
|---|---|
| 0 (the departure date itself) | 0.85 (same-day upgrade rate) |
| 1 to 3 (near-departure days) | 0.95 |
| 4 or more | 1 |

The segment is the one being upgraded, the ticket's first unflown segment, and its scheduled departure date is the next scheduled departure on the ticket.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, segment departing 18 June)

| Today | Days | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 18 June | 0 | 0.85 |
| 17 June | 1 | 0.95 |
| 15 June | 3 | 0.95 |
| 14 June | 4 | 1 |
